chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
No one is questioned in the grave except one who has rendered faith pure, purely, or one who has rendered disbelief pure, purely; and the rest are left unattended until the Day of Resurrection.

key_terms.الْإِيمَانَ: faith, in the sense of fully realized belief
key_terms.الْقَبْرِ: the grave, referring to the post-burial state
key_terms.الْكُفْرَ: disbelief, in the sense of fully realized rejection
key_terms.يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection, when ultimate reckoning occurs

ai.seo_question: Who is questioned in the grave according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that questioning in the grave is specific to those who reached a complete and manifest state of iman or kufr. Others are deferred until the Day of Resurrection, indicating a distinction in the conditions of barzakh.
